Backroom for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 11 or newer)

Install: drag Backroom into the Applications folder.

First launch: this build isn't signed or notarized by Apple, so macOS blocks the first open
with "Backroom can't be opened because Apple cannot check it for malicious software" (or
"Apple could not verify Backroom is free of malware").

  macOS 14 and older: in Applications, right-click (or Control-click) Backroom, choose Open,
  then click Open in the dialog.
  macOS 15 and newer: double-click Backroom once and click Done. Then open System Settings >
  Privacy & Security, scroll down to "Backroom was blocked", click Open Anyway, and confirm
  with your password or Touch ID.

macOS remembers the choice; after that Backroom opens normally.

Turn your volume down before the first play: the kick has a lot of low end.

Keys: Space play/stop, Esc stop, A-D or 1-4 pick a pattern slot, Up/Down tempo, Left/Right swing,
Cmd-S save. Click a step to toggle it; click a voice name to hear it. Songs are JSON files in
~/Library/Application Support/Backroom (OPEN > Open folder shows them in Finder).

Command line: /Applications/Backroom.app/Contents/MacOS/backroom --help
(for example --render to write a song to a WAV file without opening the window).

Free and open source: https://github.com/nunyabiz765/backroom
From Center Point Labs: https://centerpointlabs.dev
